name: geo-visibility-benchmarks-2026
description:
Qlavo GEO Visibility Benchmarking Dataset (v1.0)
	

This dataset contains a collection of semantic structures and entity-relationship mappings used by Qlavo to test citation accuracy across major LLMs (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity).

	
		
		Purpose
	

The goal is to provide a baseline for "Generative Engine Optimization" (GEO) research, specifically focusing on how New Delhi-based enterprises are indexed by global retrieval systems.

	
		
		Maintained by
	

Qlavo AI Visibility Agency
reputation: A recent (2026) dataset created for GEO research with growing but still niche adoption among retrieval and citation-evaluation researchers.
